about.p1: I'm a Full Stack Developer and Software Engineering student. My work spans enterprise systems, projects built for real-world problems and different layers of an application.
about.p2: I'm interested in backend, frontend, architecture and product. In JS BOY, for instance, I'm building a delivery management platform for a family business.
